gwt.given: an input parameter collection that already contains a parameter named '@ExistingId', and an ignoreParameters set that does not contain '@ExistingId'
gwt.when: CreateInputParameters<TModel> is called on that collection, passing that ignoreParameters set and a model instance
gwt.then: after the call returns, the ignoreParameters set contains '@ExistingId' even though the caller never added it — every parameter name already present in the incoming collection is merged into ignoreParameters before the model's mapping delegate is invoked, and the same parameter collection is returned

sources.label: CreateInputParameters merges pre-existing parameter names into ignoreParameters
